question: Should generic transient progress metadata become a supported public Plugin SDK reply-payload contract?
rationale: The technical need for a cross-plugin fact is established, but exporting these names creates a third-party compatibility commitment that requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Public typed progress contract
options.body: Add a typed metadata shape, document transient-only producer and consumer semantics, and lock the behavior with focused Plugin SDK compatibility tests.

options.title: Bundled-internal progress fact
options.body: Remove the public exports and retain the Codex-to-Slack signal through a non-public bundled runtime seam.

options.title: Defer portable progress semantics
options.body: Pause the PR until channel and Plugin SDK owners agree on a broader portable progress-presentation model.

recommendation.title: Public typed progress contract
recommendation.body: Add a typed metadata shape, document transient-only producer and consumer semantics, and lock the behavior with focused Plugin SDK compatibility tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this owner to both the rewritten Slack delivery architecture and the current Plugin SDK reply-payload boundary.
